questions.question: What is Latch?

options.B: A governance and access-control layer for AI agents

questions.question: In Latch terminology, what is the real API credential stored inside Latch called?
What happens to the plaintext credential after it is stored as a Latch Secret?

options.A: Latch does not return it to the user, dashboard or caller
options.C: It becomes part of every Latch token
options.D: It is sent to every connected agent

questions.question: Which prefix is used by scoped Latch access tokens?
What happens before Latch uses the real credential for an agent request?

options.A: A human must approve every call
options.B: The request passes through the policy pipeline
options.C: The credential is sent to the agent
options.D: The token is converted into USDC

questions.question: What happens when the first filter in a Latch pipeline denies a request?

options.A: The remaining filters override the denial
options.B: The request is sent upstream anyway
options.C: Evaluation short-circuits and the upstream is not called

questions.question: What status code is normally returned when a Latch policy filter denies a request?
What status code is returned when a Latch rate limit is exceeded?

Which Latch filter is used to gate access to enrolled agent identities?
Which filter can inspect an upstream reply and block or redact it before the agent sees it?
Which Latch filter is designed to enforce live daily-spending constraints?
If a Latch is extended into a child, what can the child do to the parent's authority?
How is an extended Latch's parent policy resolved?

options.A: Only once when the child is created

questions.question: What is a multi-mount Latch?

options.A: One credential copied to many agents without policies
options.B: Multiple Latch accounts merged into one wallet
options.C: Several upstream services placed behind one Latch token

questions.question: What can each mount in a multi-mount Latch have independently?

options.A: Its own upstream URL, Secret and policy pipeline

questions.question: What do services behind a multi-mount Latch share?

options.A: The same API credential in every case
options.C: The same policy rules in every case
options.D: One token and one audit trail

questions.question: What happens to Latches derived from a Secret when that underlying credential is rotated?

options.A: Every Latch must be manually recreated
options.B: They automatically use the updated credential
